flashcard_questions.q: Which Bible verse teaches that peacemakers will be called children of God?
flashcard_questions.a: Matthew 5:9, from the Sermon on the Mount.

flashcard_questions.q: What does the name As-Salaam mean among Allah’s 99 names?
What do Muslims mean by the greeting “salaam alaikum”?
What does reconciliation mean in religious teaching about conflict?
flashcard_questions.a: Restoring a broken relationship and rebuilding trust.

flashcard_questions.q: How does reconciliation differ from forgiveness?
flashcard_questions.a: Forgiveness is a personal decision; reconciliation needs both sides to work together.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Bible book teaches: “Act justly, love mercy and walk humbly with your God”?
What did Jesus pray on the cross about those crucifying him?
flashcard_questions.a: “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.”

flashcard_questions.q: What does the name Al-Ghaffar say about Allah?
flashcard_questions.a: That He is the most forgiving.

flashcard_questions.q: What position do Quakers take on violence?
flashcard_questions.a: Absolute pacifism — they reject all forms of violence.

flashcard_questions.q: Which teaching of Jesus do Christians use to argue against retaliation?
flashcard_questions.a: “If anyone strikes you on the right cheek, turn the other also” (Matthew 5:39).

flashcard_questions.q: When does the Qur’an permit Muslims to take up arms?
flashcard_questions.a: In self-defence — those who have been attacked may fight back (22:39).

flashcard_questions.q: Who must declare the lesser jihad for it to be permitted in Islam?
Which Muslim education activist said “with education you can kill terrorism”?
Which Christian minister led the American civil rights movement without violence?

notes: 14 cards: 4 belief→source (Matthew 5:9, Micah 6:8, Luke 23:34, Matthew 5:39), 4 term→definition (As-Salaam, salaam alaikum, reconciliation, Al-Ghaffar), 3 argument→view (Quaker pacifism, Qur’an on self-defence, forgiveness vs reconciliation), 2 person→significance, 1 condition of lesser jihad. Dropped 'violence' and 'terrorism' as glossary definitions that add nothing beyond everyday meaning.
